method: Exact decomposition of each linear class score into final-convolution activation contributions. PCA-space coefficients are projected to raw features with components_.T. Positive evidence for the predicted class is summed across channels and normalized independently for display.
selection_rule: All LOOCV images misclassified by all four fixed finalists; the article panel uses the lexicographically first clear and obstructed examples.
interpretation_limit: Maps are qualitative because the dataset has no obstacle segmentation or localization ground truth. They must not be interpreted as measured localization accuracy or causal attention.
